card.name: Inside drug names in interaction passages
card.fires_on: Partway through a drug name or nearby small word in drug-interaction text, where the next word is likely to be about an interaction or a co-administered drug. Seen in contraindication tables and advice on starting or stopping a second drug.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like interaction and interacting, and away from code-like tokens.
card.plain: It fires inside drug names and interaction tables, where the text is about how two drugs affect each other.
